# 3 Axial Skyrmions

- The reflection discussed alters the sign of only one pion field, resulting in a relative phase differing by π from the conventions in refs. [3, 12, 7], where the antiSkyrmion involves changing the sign of all three pion fields.  
- The definition adopted in this paper allows for a clearer comparison with the analogous scenario in monopoles.  
- According to equation (3.10), the profile function becomes zero at a distance of s/2 from the Skyrmion (or antiSkyrmion) center, enabling the Skyrmion and antiSkyrmion to be joined smoothly, and the fields are set to the vacuum outside each core.  
- Beyond the basic initial conditions from the simple ansatz in equation (3.7), the study also uses more advanced initial conditions based on the rational map ansatz [11], employing an axially symmetric charge n map.
